study type: Retrospective cohort study (integrated survival analysis of an institutional case and published literature)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 40 infants diagnosed with congenital glioblastoma within the first 3 months of life, including an institutional case and cases identified from published literature.
finding: Both surgical resection and chemotherapy were independently associated with superior overall survival in infants with congenital glioblastoma.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with greater odds of surgical diagnosis compared to autopsy diagnosis.
